title: Finite length at the generic point of a component and maximal dimension points of a closed subscheme
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma records that the length of the local ring of a closed subscheme at the generic point of one of its components is finite, and that a point where the relative dimension function attains the maximal value on the subscheme is the generic point of a component (statement lines 1628-1644, tag 02QJ-adjacent). The first part uses that the local ring there is zero dimensional hence of finite length, and the second is a direct closure argument. The dimension zero argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
